name: Wayland-Safe Tab Shortcuts
description: Wayland-safe shortcuts to swallow Ctrl+W, close highlighted tabs, duplicate tabs, and move tabs to a new window.

close-highlighted-tabs.description: Close highlighted tabs in the focused window

duplicate-tab.description: Duplicate highlighted tab(s) in the focused window

tab-to-window.description: Move highlighted tab(s) to a new normal window

tab-to-popup.description: Move active tab to a new popup window

close-other-tabs.description: Close other unpinned tabs in the focused window
